name: Alohi
summary: Document workflow tools from one company: Sign.Plus e-signatures, Fax.Plus online faxing and Scan.Plus scanning. Paperwork is handled and compliance is included.
best_for: businesses that need secure online faxing, e-signatures or scanning: especially regulated ones needing HIPAA-compliant fax on the Enterprise tier
skip_if: you only need occasional e-signatures (a single dedicated tool may be cheaper) or your document volume is low enough for free options
honest_knock: The honest catch is that Alohi is a suite of separate products: Fax.Plus, Sign.Plus, Scan.Plus: each with its own subscription, so "one ecosystem" can mean several line items if you want e-signatures and faxing and scanning. Page and member limits on the lower tiers are modest, and HIPAA/BAA sits only on the top tier. For a single job (say online faxing), it's clean and cheap; for the full workflow, add up the parts.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-10 and re-read unchanged 2026-09-27 and 2026-11-19 on fax.plus/pricing and sign.plus/pricing) Priced per product, in USD, with a currency switcher offering EUR, CHF and GBP. IMPORTANT: on Fax.Plus the '/month' figure on each card is the annual rate. Fax.Plus — Basic $6.99 a month billed as $83.99 annually (200 pages a month, one fax number, one member, $0.10 per extra page, 60 pages maximum per fax); Premium $13.99 / $167.99 (500 pages, $0.07 per extra page, 90 pages per fax, adds toll-free numbers, number porting, CSV log export and the ability to switch off reception); Business $27.99 / $335.99 (1,000 pages); Enterprise $79.99 a month on annual billing, $959.99 a year, and the only card that also shows a monthly-billing rate, 'starts at $99.99' (4,000 pages, multiple fax numbers, unlimited members, $0.03 per extra page, 250 pages per fax, 1,000 AI credits a month, SSO, HIPAA-compliant with BAA, the Fax.Plus API, data residency and Zapier). The banner offers 'up to 3 months free with an annual plan (save up to 22%)'. A free plan gives 10 pages in total, not per month. Extra fax numbers are $4.99 a month (Business and Enterprise include two); vanity numbers $19.99; choosing your own number within a region is a one-time $19.99, or $29.99 from their handpicked memorable set. Porting is free but country-dependent — porting a US or Canadian number requires Premium or higher. The footnotes warn that faxes to certain destinations may count as multiple pages, priced on a separate Sending Rates page, and that taxes are excluded. Sign.Plus is a separate subscription and prints annual and monthly rates side by side: Free (3 signature requests in total, 1 template, 1 user), Personal $9.99 annual / $14.99 monthly, $119.99 a year (1 user, 10 signature requests a month, 5 templates), Professional $19.99 / $29.99 per user, $239.99 a year (up to 5 users, unlimited requests, 10 templates), Business $29.99 / $49.99 per user, $359.99 a year (unlimited templates, document sharing, Zapier, custom branding), Enterprise $49.99 / $79.99 per user, $599.99 a year (SSO, HIPAA-compliant with BAA, advanced security controls, data residency, priority support). Sign.Plus advertises 'save up to 40% with annual plans'. Request via SMS/WhatsApp is metered separately at 10, 30 and 150 a month from Professional upward. The Fax.Plus page's structured product data, read 27 September 2026, also lists monthly-billing prices for the lower tiers that the cards do not print: Basic $8.99, Premium $17.99, Business $34.99 and Enterprise $99.99 a month.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Fax.Plus, the fax product of Alohi, on the Free plan of an account we created. The free plan is 10 pages to send in total, not per month, and it has no fax number, so you cannot receive faxes without paying. A one-page fax to a made-up test number was ready to send in about 4 minutes and was deliberately not sent. From the Netherlands all prices showed in euros, with the same figures the dossier lists in dollars. Upgrade opened a checkout with Premium (Annual) at EUR 167.99 already chosen and a Dutch number that requires proof of ID; it was left with nothing filled in. Account and start: we created the account and entered the text message code himself; our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026. A first attempt at 09:39 stopped at that code; the test resumed at 09:46 and ended at 09:51 CET. The interface was in English (lng=en). Alohi is a suite of separate products; this test covers Fax.Plus. The dossier name is Alohi and the review is on AIBM (b2b/alohi-review). The inbox showed 10 fax pages left, Get a Fax Number, Send Fax and one Welcome Fax from Fax.Plus, with a bar saying Receiving faxes requires a dedicated fax number. Core action, prepare an outgoing fax: Send Fax showed Remaining Pages: 10. The made-up US test number +1 202 555 0123 was entered as recipient, Add Page, Rich Text Editor made one text page, Test fax. Not sent., and Confirm added it as a 14.7 KB page. Send was active and was not clicked, so no fax went out and no page was used. This took about 4 minutes and 6 steps. Next to Add Page there are a Cover Sheet Generator and a Cover Sheet Gallery. There is no test number or test route: the 10 free pages are the trial. Numbers said No numbers, Add a number to receive faxes: a free fax number does not exist, so receiving needs a paid plan. Plan & Billing: Plan Type Free, Remaining Pages 10, Alohi AI 0 AI Credits, Current Credit EUR 0, Payment Method Not Available, Default Currency EUR. Plans: On fax.plus/pricing, annual billing, in euros from the Netherlands: Basic EUR 6.99 a month (EUR 83.99 a year) with 200 pages, 1 number, 1 member, EUR 0.10 per extra page and 60 pages per fax; Premium EUR 13.99 a month (EUR 167.99 a year, Recommended) with 500 pages, EUR 0.07 per extra page, 90 pages per fax, toll-free numbers and number porting; Business EUR 27.99 a month (EUR 335.99 a year) with 1,000 pages, 5 members, EUR 0.05 per extra page and 200 pages per fax; Enterprise EUR 79.99 a month (EUR 959.99 a year) with 4,000 pages, HIPAA with a BAA, SSO, API, EUR 0.03 per extra page and 250 pages per fax. The free plan in the comparison has 10 pages in total, EUR 0.20 per extra page, 30 pages per fax and no inbound faxes. An annual plan gives up to 3 months free (save up to 22%). An extra number is EUR 4.99 a month and a custom number EUR 19.99 once; the page says No setup fee. Checkout: Upgrade opened the checkout with Premium (Annual) EUR 167.99 (EUR 13.99 per month) preselected; step 2 Your Fax Number with Netherlands (Requires proof of ID) and a Random or Custom (EUR 19.99) number; step 3 Payment Details with card, PayPal, Google Pay and Apple Pay; step 4 billing address; Secure checkout powered by Stripe. The Order Summary still showed Nothing added yet and Total EUR 0 while it loaded. Nothing was filled in and nothing was paid. Cancelling: no paid plan, so no cancel button. The pricing FAQ says monthly plans renew each month and annual plans once a year and that changes can be made in the account settings; Plan & Billing on Free only shows Upgrade. The account stays on Free. Not tested: actually sending a fax (on purpose), receiving a fax (needs a paid number), Sign.Plus and Scan.Plus, and cancelling a paid plan. Clean up: the account stays on Free with 10 pages; the draft fax was not sent or saved. The own tab was closed and our tabs were not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free plan is 10 pages in total with no number, so it can only test sending. The checkout opens on an annual Premium plan by default, not on the cheaper Basic or a monthly term. A Dutch fax number requires proof of ID. Each Alohi product (fax, signing, scanning) is a separate subscription.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Fax.Plus, the fax product of Alohi, on the Free plan of an account we created. The free plan is 10 pages to send in total, not per month, and it has no fax number, so you cannot receive faxes without paying. A one-page fax to a made-up test number was ready to send in about 4 minutes and was deliberately not sent. From the Netherlands all prices showed in euros, with the same figures the dossier lists in dollars. Upgrade opened a checkout with Premium (Annual) at EUR 167.99 already chosen and a Dutch number that requires proof of ID; it was left with nothing filled in. Account and start: we created the account and entered the text message code himself; our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026. A first attempt at 09:39 stopped at that code; the test resumed at 09:46 and ended at 09:51 CET. The interface was in English (lng=en). Alohi is a suite of separate products; this test covers Fax.Plus. The dossier name is Alohi and the review is on AIBM (b2b/alohi-review). The inbox showed 10 fax pages left, Get a Fax Number, Send Fax and one Welcome Fax from Fax.Plus, with a bar saying Receiving faxes requires a dedicated fax number. Core action, prepare an outgoing fax: Send Fax showed Remaining Pages: 10. The made-up US test number +1 202 555 0123 was entered as recipient, Add Page, Rich Text Editor made one text page, Test fax. Not sent., and Confirm added it as a 14.7 KB page. Send was active and was not clicked, so no fax went out and no page was used. This took about 4 minutes and 6 steps. Next to Add Page there are a Cover Sheet Generator and a Cover Sheet Gallery. There is no test number or test route: the 10 free pages are the trial. Numbers said No numbers, Add a number to receive faxes: a free fax number does not exist, so receiving needs a paid plan. Plan & Billing: Plan Type Free, Remaining Pages 10, Alohi AI 0 AI Credits, Current Credit EUR 0, Payment Method Not Available, Default Currency EUR. Plans: On fax.plus/pricing, annual billing, in euros from the Netherlands: Basic EUR 6.99 a month (EUR 83.99 a year) with 200 pages, 1 number, 1 member, EUR 0.10 per extra page and 60 pages per fax; Premium EUR 13.99 a month (EUR 167.99 a year, Recommended) with 500 pages, EUR 0.07 per extra page, 90 pages per fax, toll-free numbers and number porting; Business EUR 27.99 a month (EUR 335.99 a year) with 1,000 pages, 5 members, EUR 0.05 per extra page and 200 pages per fax; Enterprise EUR 79.99 a month (EUR 959.99 a year) with 4,000 pages, HIPAA with a BAA, SSO, API, EUR 0.03 per extra page and 250 pages per fax. The free plan in the comparison has 10 pages in total, EUR 0.20 per extra page, 30 pages per fax and no inbound faxes. An annual plan gives up to 3 months free (save up to 22%). An extra number is EUR 4.99 a month and a custom number EUR 19.99 once; the page says No setup fee. Checkout: Upgrade opened the checkout with Premium (Annual) EUR 167.99 (EUR 13.99 per month) preselected; step 2 Your Fax Number with Netherlands (Requires proof of ID) and a Random or Custom (EUR 19.99) number; step 3 Payment Details with card, PayPal, Google Pay and Apple Pay; step 4 billing address; Secure checkout powered by Stripe. The Order Summary still showed Nothing added yet and Total EUR 0 while it loaded. Nothing was filled in and nothing was paid. Cancelling: no paid plan, so no cancel button. The pricing FAQ says monthly plans renew each month and annual plans once a year and that changes can be made in the account settings; Plan & Billing on Free only shows Upgrade. The account stays on Free. Not tested: actually sending a fax (on purpose), receiving a fax (needs a paid number), Sign.Plus and Scan.Plus, and cancelling a paid plan. Clean up: the account stays on Free with 10 pages; the draft fax was not sent or saved. The own tab was closed and our tabs were not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free plan is 10 pages in total with no number, so it can only test sending. The checkout opens on an annual Premium plan by default, not on the cheaper Basic or a monthly term. A Dutch fax number requires proof of ID. Each Alohi product (fax, signing, scanning) is a separate subscription.
